ex.s: Therefore, just as we need to be more thoughtful about our caloric consumption, we also need to be more thoughtful about our information consumption, resisting the temptation of the mental “junk food” in order to manage our time most effectively.
ex.t: 因此，正如我们需要更审慎地对待热量摄入，我们也需要更审慎地对待信息摄入，抵制精神“垃圾食品”的诱惑，以最有效地管理时间。

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论多么努力取悦，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终令人释然。

ex.s: A comprehensive study of 4, 500 children conducted by the National Institutes of Health in 2018 shows that children who spent more than seven hours a day staring at screens showed evidence of premature thinning of their brain's cortex-the outer layer that processes sensory information.

ex.s: If Tononi’s theory is right, it would explain why, when we miss a night’s, we find it harder the next day to concentrate and learn new information — our brains may have smaller room for new experiences.
ex.t: 如果托诺尼的理论是对的，就能解释为什么我们少睡一夜后，第二天更难集中注意力和学习新信息——我们的大脑可能为新体验留出的空间更小了。

ex.s: As you listen, make notes of key information such as names, numbers, facts and instructions.
ex.t: 听的时候，把关键信息记下来，比如姓名、数字、事实和指示。

ex.s: This will help you understand and remember the information you hear.
ex.t: 这将帮助你理解并记住你听到的信息。

ex.s: When scanning a text, you read it quickly in order to find a specific piece of information.
ex.t: 在扫描一个文本时，您会快速读取，以便找到一个特定的信息片段。

ex.s: At the information desk at the entrance, I asked a lady where the shoe section was.

ex.s: Our formative environment as a species was information-poor, so our brains developed a mechanism that prized new information.
ex.t: 作为人类，我们形成期的环境是信息匮乏的，因此我们的大脑形成了一种重视新信息的机制。

ex.s: For young people, information technology skills will play an increasing role in the future.
ex.t: 对年轻人来说，信息技术技能在未来将扮演越来越重要的角色。
